The test checks selected manifest refs, successful native report, matching estimand, non-heuristic/non-gate-eligible native interval, fixture-only/non-production basis, equal point identification lower/upper (2.125), statistical endpoints preserved separately from projected report CI, same coordinate across different methods, and at least one asymmetric native interval. Source _value_estimand_coordinate hashes all EstimandSpec dataclass fields; producer and consumer validate profile/outcome/unit/assignment/request/report/basis lineage and exact panel bytes. The separate test currently binds one unit only; no unit-change/rescaling metamorphic control is present.
residuals: The producer's fixture identification bounds are assigned as 2.125/2.125, not produced by an identification algorithm. This tests point-set versus CI representation, not a genuine nonzero partial-identification set.

No positive owner-basis producer with nonzero identification width is demonstrated. The old width-4 assertion was invalid because it used a statistical CI as ID bounds; its removal is correct and must not be reported as partial-ID support.

There is a source-level same-coordinate binding over subject/population/horizon/unit fields, but the test does not vary those fields to prove distinct coordinates, and it does not test unit conversion/rescaling consistency.
